description: Use when an agent needs untrusted text screened for prompt-injection attempts. Returns no_injection_found, suspicious or malicious for up to 4,000 characters, with the matched rules (role tags, hidden Unicode, encoded payloads) and a model's view. Costs 0.004 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).
